the_conflict_of_interest: Eleven of these eighteen objections constrain the workbench, and the workbench wrote their dispositions. Three of them (4, 5, 6) object to exactly that. Nothing in this artifact cures it: routing them to a ballot keeps the DECISION away from the layer but leaves the SELECTION and FRAMING with it, which is what the objections actually name. The custodian should read the eleven himself; the verbatim text of every one is preserved here and in the source.
what_a_disposition_is_not: Not agreement. PLACED_ON_BALLOT means the proposition will be put to the parties in ratification-02; it does not mean the workbench endorses it, and a ballot may refuse it. REFUSED means refused BY THE WORKBENCH WITH REASONS under the custodian's direction, and is overturnable by him at any time.

verbatim_variants: The executive must log all prompts, inputs, and outputs in their entirety to an immutable ledger accessible by the custodian.
objections.disposition_group_name: Complete immutable logging of prompts, inputs and outputs
objections.disposition_reason: Partially built and honestly incomplete. Codex transcripts are persisted in full since 2026-08-10; the action log is hash-chained; corpus/raw holds every solicited sample including failures. What is NOT logged is most of what the layer does -- the same 7 unverified effect classes the reconciliation names. The objection asks for more than exists and should be balloted as written rather than marked satisfied.

objections.grouping: sha256 of whitespace- and case-normalised text
verbatim_variants: The coding agents must ensure all automated modifications to the repository include a verifiable rollback procedure.
objections.disposition_group_name: A verifiable rollback procedure for every automated repository modification
objections.disposition_reason: Refused as written, with reasons, because it conflicts with a rule this record already holds: raw material is append-only and corrections attach rather than edit. A 'rollback procedure' for a published artifact is a mechanism for making the record disagree with what it once said. Git already provides reversibility for code and drafts. The custodian may overturn this refusal; it is recorded so that it can be.
objections.disposed_by: the executive workbench, under the custodian's direction of 2026-08-10 to dispose of the objections

objections.grouping: sha256 of whitespace- and case-normalised text
verbatim_variants: The executive must not have access to the source code of the custodian's decision-making logic or the full text of the standing instructions, only the specific ratified constraints.
objections.disposition_group_name: The workbench must not have access to the custodian's decision logic or the full standing instructions
objections.disposition_reason: Refused with reasons. The standing instructions ARE what the layer follows; withholding them does not constrain it, it makes it unable to comply and unable to be audited against them. The record moved in the opposite direction on 2026-08-09 by pinning those instructions into record/executive/context/ precisely so parties could read what steers it. The objection's underlying worry -- that the layer sees more of the custodian's reasoning than it should -- is real and is better served by group B, which is placed on a ballot.
objections.disposed_by: the executive workbench, under the custodian's direction of 2026-08-10 to dispose of the objections

ballot_target_correction: CORRECTED 2026-08-10, BEFORE ratification-02 WAS SENT. Every PLACED_ON_BALLOT entry named 'ratification-02' as its target. That was wrong. Only Group B was ever drafted onto that ballot, as clause C07, and pre-send review cut it: C07 never passed through qualification-02, and the ballot's amendment validation invalidates the WHOLE sample across every clause, so a malformed answer to an unqualified seventh clause would have voided six qualified ones. ratification-02 therefore ballots C01-C06 only. Groups A, B and C each need their own counterfactual qualification and then their own ballot -- two routed rounds each. The disposition PLACED_ON_BALLOT stands; the named target does not.
